description: Resolve ASIN, Amazon URL, or keywords to a buyUrl on the chosen storefront. amazon.com links carry sw-petbox-20, amazon.se links sw-petbox-21 (trackingTag). marketplace optional (fallback: country → en-US → amazon.com → else amazon.se).

country.description: ISO country of the shopper, used when marketplace is omitted: US → amazon.com, SE → amazon.se.

locale.description: User locale, e.g. en-US (US shoppers → amazon.com) or sv-SE (Sweden → amazon.se). If marketplace and country are omitted, en-US selects amazon.com.

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront: amazon.com (United States — 224 hand-picked products, English, USD, /dp/ links tagged sw-petbox-20) or amazon.se (Sweden, default — 440 products, tag sw-petbox-21); ids us / se also work. Optional: when omitted → country, then locale / Accept-Language en-US → amazon.com, otherwise amazon.se. Other storefronts get search links.

name: resolve_product
title: Resolve buy link
